pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, jagged geometries with high-frequency edge serration. Patch size is non-uniform, scaling down significantly from the dorsal neck region toward the posterior flank, where they become minute and fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, light-colored interstitial pathways on the neck and shoulder, narrowing into a dense, fine-lined grid on the lower flank. Network nodes are predominantly tri-radial or quadri-radial with consistent pixel thickness in the cervical region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper neck; presents as a short, continuous mane with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct gradient in patch density and size across the lateral axis, transitioning from large, stellate polygonal structures on the neck to micro-patches on the hindquarters.
